name: search-panel
author: lumine-code
description: Find and replace within buffers and across the project.

focusEditorAfterSearch.title: Focus editor after search
focusEditorAfterSearch.description: Focus the editor and select the next match when a file search is executed. If no matches are found, the editor will not be focused.

projectSearchResultsPaneSplitDirection.title: Direction to open results pane
projectSearchResultsPaneSplitDirection.description: Direction to split the active pane when showing project search results. If 'none', the results will be shown in the active pane.

closeFindPanelAfterSearch.title: Close project find panel after search
closeFindPanelAfterSearch.description: Close the find panel after executing a project-wide search.

scrollToResultOnLiveSearch.title: Scroll to result on live-search (incremental find in buffer)
scrollToResultOnLiveSearch.description: Scroll to and select the closest match while typing in the buffer find box.

liveSearchMinimumCharacters.title: Live search minimum characters
liveSearchMinimumCharacters.description: The minimum number of characters which need to be typed into the buffer find box before search starts matching and highlighting matches as you type.

searchContextLineCountBefore.title: Search context line count before
searchContextLineCountBefore.description: The number of extra lines of context to query before the match for project results

searchContextLineCountAfter.title: Search context line count after
searchContextLineCountAfter.description: The number of extra lines of context to query after the match for project results

showSearchWrapIcon.title: Show search wrap icon
showSearchWrapIcon.description: Display a visual cue over the editor when looping through search results.

enablePCRE2.title: Enable PCRE2 regex engine
enablePCRE2.description: Enable the PCRE2 regex engine. This enables additional regex features such as lookbehind, but may make searches slower.

ignoredNames.title: Ignored Names
ignoredNames.description: Additional file and directory names to exclude from project searches. The project-wide core ignored names are also used by default.

autocompleteSearches.title: Autocomplete search
autocompleteSearches.description: Autocompletes entries in the find search field.

preserveCaseOnReplace.title: Preserve case during replace
preserveCaseOnReplace.description: Keep the replaced text case during replace: replacing 'user' with 'person' will replace 'User' with 'Person' and 'USER' with 'PERSON'.

cleanOnHide.title: Clean on panel hide
cleanOnHide.description: Clear the search and replace fields when closing the find panel.

marker.title: Marker
marker.description: Settings of the search-panel layer drawn on the scrollbar and minimap by the marker hub.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show search results on the scrollbar and minimap.

permanent.title: Permanent view
permanent.description: Keep markers visible even when the find panel is closed.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Hide markers if count exceeds this value. Zero means no limit.

search.control.description: Search panel service with find options, panel controls, and search triggers
